test_title: PYST 04: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four parts. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

He was acquitted to / a cyber crime / on the basis of evidence / given to the court.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. He was acquitted to .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a legal term usage where "acquitted" should be followed by "of" instead of "to".
 
• The correct form is "He was acquitted of a cyber crime."
 
• The preposition "of" is used to indicate the reason or cause of the acquittal.

Correct sentence: *He was acquitted of a cyber crime on the basis of evidence given to the court*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Acquittal:**
 
 
• **Definition:** A legal judgment that officially and formally clears a defendant of criminal charges.
 
• **Example:** The jury acquitted him of all charges.
